ayahs.meta_en: Enclosure in the Hermetically Sealed Vault of Fire
ayahs.lexicon_modern_notes: Root أ-ص-দ ('-ṣ-d): vaulted closure, inescapable thermal containment.

english_translations.sahih_international: Over them will be fire closed in.
english_translations.pickthall: Fire will be an awning over them.
english_translations.yusuf_ali: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).
english_translations.shakir: On them is fire closed over.
english_translations.muhammad_sarwar: who will be engulfed in the fire.
english_translations.mohsin_khan: The Fire will be shut over them (i.e. they will be enveloped by the Fire without any opening or window or outlet.
english_translations.arberry: over them is a Fire covered down.
